correctness.rationale: The exact beta-integral moment formula reduces the claim to a symmetric log-gamma curvature identity. Gauss multiplication expresses each curvature as a finite trigamma sum. Strict decrease of trigamma plus the coordinatewise grid comparison proves negative second derivative for every parameter, not by sampling. Polar symmetry and exact endpoint moments finish the claim; the packaged checker replayed successfully as an independent consistency check.

value.rationale: The dual ell_p balls are the canonical one-parameter polar family for Ball's newly resolved moment inequality. Turning the global bound into a strict reciprocal-exponent log-concavity theorem gives a natural complete classification of the entire family, including unique center and exact endpoint, rather than an arbitrary numeric slice or routine substitution.
